purpose: Record an independent visual source-image review of the official Igembe North Form 34B final TOTAL row and preserve an internal source arithmetic conflict without promotion.

sample.review_context_note: This constituency's TOTAL row uses plain (unshaded) formatting rather than the more common green band, so the automated row locator did not isolate it; the row was located and cropped manually at 500 DPI directly from the freshly downloaded, sha256-verified official IEBC Form 34B PDF. The page also carries a separate printed 'Voter Turn Out' summary box (Total registered voters / Total voters who turned out / Percentage of Voter turnout) below the polling-station table, independently confirming the same Registered Voters and (Total Valid Votes + Rejected Ballots) figures. The portal only served this PDF after a home-page + set-election (2022 General Election, election id 5) session handshake.

review.reviewed_by: Claude Sonnet 5 (Anthropic), acting as an independent Kenya Data Atlas contributor agent
review.independence_note: The official Form 34B PDF was downloaded fresh directly from forms.iebc.or.ke in this session, its sha256 was computed from the downloaded bytes, and the TOTAL row integers were read directly from the rendered page image (a clean digital scan). No OCR, machine-candidate pipeline, or prior extraction artifact was used or consulted before recording these values. Constituency identity (IGEMBE NORTH, code 053, county MERU code 012) was read from the page header ('Name of Constituency: IGEMBE NORTH Code: 053', 'Name of County: MERU Code: 012') and the visible 'CON 053' banner marker before this row was accepted.

same_row_valid_vote_reconciliation.method: Independent visual read of the four presidential candidate total cells on the same final TOTAL row, cross-checked against the page's separate printed 'Voter Turn Out' summary box.

row_reconciliation.voter_turnout_box_cross_check: The page's own printed 'Voter Turn Out' summary box states Total registered voters 77,050 and Total voters who turned out 50,677 (= printed Total Valid Votes 49,933 + printed Rejected Ballots 744 exactly), confirming the printed TOTAL row figures are the form's own intended grand totals rather than a misread by this review.
row_reconciliation.likely_source_of_conflict: One data-row above the TOTAL line ('012053026508801 KATHANGA PRIMARY SCHOOL', registered 645) prints an internally impossible Total Valid Votes of 988 against its own registered-voters figure of 645 -- itself a visible printing/tabulation anomaly on the official source page. 988 minus that row's own candidate-column sum (247+95+1+0=343) equals 645, exactly the constituency-wide candidate-sum shortfall, suggesting the anomaly at that single polling station explains the aggregate conflict. This review does not correct or infer a replacement value for that station; it only reports what both the TOTAL row and the Voter Turn Out box print.

note: Registered voters, total valid votes and rejected ballots are each individually clear and unambiguous on the printed TOTAL row of a clean digital scan, and reconcile exactly to the page's own separate 'Voter Turn Out' summary box (77,050 registered; 49,933 + 744 = 50,677 turned out). However, the four candidate-vote cells on that same row sum to only 49,288, a shortfall of 645 against the row's own printed Total Valid Votes of 49,933. This is a genuine internal arithmetic inconsistency on the official source form itself (traceable to an internally impossible Total Valid Votes value of 988 printed against only 645 registered voters at one upstream polling station, 'KATHANGA PRIMARY SCHOOL'), not a transcription ambiguity by this review. Per the extraction contract's prohibition on silently correcting digits to force reconciliation, this conflict is preserved unresolved and no turnout observation may be promoted from this evidence.
